image_description: A close-up shot of a bagel sandwich on a white plate. The bagel is sliced horizontally with a filling that appears to include a blue, translucent layer (possibly plastic or gelatinous food item) and a textured brown patty. The bagel has a golden-brown crust with visible sesame seeds.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The blue layer in the filling is physically nonsensical. It appears translucent and plastic-like, lacking the structure of any known food ingredient. It seems to merge with the brown patty without clear boundaries, suggesting a failure in material rendering.

artifact_observations.location: Interface between filling and bottom bagel half
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary between the filling and the bottom bun is blurry and indistinct. The textures seem to bleed into each other rather than maintaining separate physical identities.
The rim of the white plate shows slight warping and inconsistent thickness, particularly on the right side, which may indicate minor geometric instability.
